plan.summary: BRO-5874: Bachtrack rows that review a different production or are not reviews. Decided from each page's title/byline (read 2026-10-22), not the url. Flagging them keeps the new Browserbase route (bachtrack.com in knownBlockedSites) from spending sessions on them. Also fixes the Lincoln critic name typo.
steps: Flag pinocchio-west-end-2017 Bachtrack row wrongProduction (Boesmans opera, Aix Festival July 2017; show is the National Theatre musical at the Lyttelton)
Flag the-turn-of-the-screw-off-west-end-2026 Bachtrack row wrongProduction (Victorian Opera, Melbourne; show is at the Arcola)
Delete table-17-off-west-end-2026 Bachtrack row (url is a /concert-event/ listing for The Haunted Keyboard, not a review of Table 17)
Correct Lincoln in the Bardo critic name to the page byline Susan Stempleski
